blocks.zh: 4.9 Storage 儲存
blocks.en: 4.9 Storage

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Storage (儲存)：在生物製藥製程中，儲存是連接各單元操作的「緩衝帶」。無論是緩衝液、培養基還是製程中間體，都需要在適當條件下保存，以維持其品質屬性直到下一步處理。
blocks.en: Storage: In biopharmaceutical processes, storage is the "buffer zone" that links the unit operations. Buffers, culture media and process intermediates all have to be held under suitable conditions so that their quality attributes are maintained until the next processing step.

blocks.zh: Polyethylene Fluid Contact Layer (聚乙烯流體接觸層)：PE（特別是 LDPE 低密度聚乙烯）是最常見的 SUS 袋體接液面材料，因其化學惰性高、反應性極低，適用於大多數水溶液中間體。
blocks.en: Polyethylene Fluid Contact Layer: PE (especially LDPE, low-density polyethylene) is the most common fluid contact material for SUS bags because of its high chemical inertness and very low reactivity, which suits most aqueous intermediates.

blocks.zh: EVOH Gas Barrier (EVOH 氣體阻隔層)：EVA 袋與 EVOH 結合形成多層複合膜，可同時提供低溫機械強度和氣體滲透阻隔，這對於氧氣敏感的蛋白質藥物特別重要。
blocks.en: EVOH Gas Barrier: EVA bags combined with EVOH form a multilayer composite film that provides both mechanical strength at low temperature and a barrier to gas permeation. This is especially important for oxygen-sensitive protein drugs.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你去超市買了生鮮食品 — 有些可以放在室溫（短期儲存），有些必須冰在冰箱（冷藏），更脆弱的需要放冷凍庫（冷凍保存）。而你用來裝食物的容器材質也很重要：塑膠保鮮盒、真空袋或鋁箔袋各有其阻隔效果。SUS 的儲存袋選擇也是同樣邏輯 — 要根據中間體的敏感度選擇材料和溫度條件。
blocks.en: Think of buying fresh food at the supermarket: some items can stay at room temperature (short-term storage), some must go in the refrigerator (chilled storage), and the most delicate need the freezer (frozen storage). The material of the container also matters: plastic boxes, vacuum bags and foil bags each give a different barrier effect. Choosing SUS storage bags follows the same logic: select the material and temperature conditions according to the sensitivity of the intermediate.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Leachables 風險：長期儲存時，聚合物材料中的化學物質可能會浸出（leach）到製程液體中。這些 leachables 不僅影響中間體品質，還可能被「帶」到下游單元操作中，對最終產品造成影響。因此必須做儲存相容性研究。
blocks.en: Leachables risk: During long-term storage, chemicals in the polymer materials may leach into the process fluid. These leachables can affect not only the quality of the intermediate but can also be "carried" into downstream unit operations and impact the final product. A storage compatibility study is therefore required.

blocks.zh: 光敏性與氧敏性保護：對於含光敏或氧敏成分的中間體，需使用特殊保護膜（如遮光膜或氧氣阻隔膜），這是標準 PE 袋可能無法滿足的地方。
blocks.en: Protection against light and oxygen: Intermediates containing light-sensitive or oxygen-sensitive components need special protective films (such as light-blocking or oxygen-barrier films), which a standard PE bag may not provide.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼低密度聚乙烯（LDPE）特別適合作為 SUS 儲存袋的接液面材料？其化學惰性與什麼製程需求相關？
blocks.en: Why is low-density polyethylene (LDPE) particularly suitable as the fluid contact layer of SUS storage bags? Which process requirements does its chemical inertness relate to?

blocks.zh: 如果你的製程中間體是一種氧氣敏感的單株抗體，你會如何選擇儲存袋的膜層結構？
blocks.en: If your process intermediate is an oxygen-sensitive monoclonal antibody, how would you select the film layer structure of the storage bag?

blocks.zh: 長期儲存時，leachables 評估應包含哪些關鍵測試項目？
blocks.en: For long-term storage, what key test items should a leachables assessment include?

blocks.zh: 4.10 Freezing 冷凍
blocks.en: 4.10 Freezing

blocks.zh: Controlled Freeze-Thaw (控制凍融)：與在一般冰箱中隨意冷凍（uncontrolled freezing）不同，控制凍融系統使用接觸式冷凍板來精確控制冷凍速率。這對於生物藥品（如蛋白質、抗體）特別重要，因為不均勻的冷凍會導致局部濃縮效應（cryoconcentration），可能使蛋白質聚集或降解。
blocks.en: Controlled Freeze-Thaw: Unlike uncontrolled freezing in an ordinary freezer, controlled freeze-thaw systems use contact freezing plates to control the freezing rate precisely. This is especially important for biological drugs (such as proteins and antibodies), because non-uniform freezing causes local concentration effects (cryoconcentration), which may lead to protein aggregation or degradation.

blocks.zh: Glass Transition Temperature (玻璃轉化溫度, Tg)：在 -40°C 至 -70°C 的典型儲存溫度下，大多數高分子材料會低於其 Tg 而變脆。這就是為什麼冷凍用 SUS 需要選擇 PTFE 或 EVA 等在低溫下仍保持機械強度的特殊材料。
blocks.en: Glass Transition Temperature (Tg): At typical storage temperatures of -40°C to -70°C, most polymer materials fall below their Tg and become brittle. This is why SUS for freezing need special materials such as PTFE or EVA that retain mechanical strength at low temperature.

blocks.zh: 這就像搬運冰雕一樣 — 你不會用普通紙箱搬運冰雕，而需要專用的保護外殼和緩衝材料。冷凍袋也是如此：未受保護的小袋在低溫下變脆，稍有碰撞就可能破裂（就像冰雕碎裂）。帶有硬殼保護的整合式袋體（integrated shell-protected bag）就是為冰雕量身訂做的運輸箱。
blocks.en: It is like transporting an ice sculpture: you would not carry it in an ordinary cardboard box; you need a dedicated protective shell and cushioning. Freezing bags are the same: an unprotected small bag becomes brittle at low temperature and can crack at the slightest knock (like an ice sculpture shattering). An integrated shell-protected bag is the custom-made shipping case for the ice sculpture.

blocks.zh: 人員培訓至關重要：文件特別強調「有效的員工培訓對於成功實施 SUS 凍融步驟至關重要」。這是因為冷凍袋在低溫下非常脆弱，操作人員的不當處理（如摔落、急速搬動）是袋體破損的主要原因之一。
blocks.en: Personnel training is essential: The document specifically stresses that "effective employee training is essential for successful implementation of SUS freeze-thaw steps". Freezing bags are very fragile at low temperature, and improper handling by operators (such as dropping or moving them abruptly) is one of the main causes of bag breakage.

blocks.zh: 管路接頭是最常見的失效點：整合式外殼設計特別包含管路和接頭的保護腔室，因為這些連接點在低溫下最容易發生洩漏或斷裂。
blocks.en: Tubing connections are the most common failure point: Integrated shell designs specifically include protective compartments for tubing and connectors, because these connection points are the most likely to leak or break at low temperature.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 假設你是一家 CDMO，正在為客戶的單株抗體原液（bulk drug substance）建立冷凍保存流程。你需要考慮：
blocks.en: Suppose you are a CDMO setting up a frozen storage process for a customer's monoclonal antibody bulk drug substance. You need to consider the following:

blocks.zh: 選擇 EVA/EVOH 多層膜冷凍袋，確保在 -70°C 下的機械強度
blocks.en: Select EVA/EVOH multilayer freezing bags to ensure mechanical strength at -70°C

blocks.zh: 投資控制凍融設備（如 Sartorius 或 CryoFin 系統）以確保可重現的冷凍曲線
blocks.en: Invest in controlled freeze-thaw equipment (such as Sartorius or CryoFin systems) to ensure a reproducible freezing profile

blocks.zh: 建立 SOP 訓練操作人員正確處理冷凍袋
blocks.en: Establish an SOP to train operators in the correct handling of freezing bags

blocks.zh: 規劃冷鏈運輸方案，使用 ISTA/ASTM 合格的運輸容器
blocks.en: Plan a cold chain transportation scheme using ISTA/ASTM-qualified shipping containers

blocks.zh: 為什麼「非控制凍融」在未受保護的小袋中失敗率較高？從材料科學和操作因素兩方面解釋。
blocks.en: Why is the failure rate of uncontrolled freeze-thaw higher in unprotected small bags? Explain from both the materials science and the operational perspective.

blocks.zh: 控制凍融系統的「接觸式冷凍板」如何改善冷凍均勻性？這對蛋白質品質有何影響？
blocks.en: How does the "contact freezing plate" of a controlled freeze-thaw system improve freezing uniformity? What does this mean for protein quality?

blocks.zh: 4.11 Filtration 過濾
blocks.en: 4.11 Filtration

blocks.zh: NFF vs CFF（正向過濾 vs 交叉流過濾）：
blocks.en: NFF vs CFF (normal flow filtration vs cross flow filtration):

blocks.zh: NFF (Normal Flow Filtration / 正向過濾)：液體垂直通過濾膜，用於去除微粒、微生物和病毒顆粒。深層過濾（depth filter）和除菌過濾（sterilizing filter）都屬於此類。
blocks.en: NFF (Normal Flow Filtration): The liquid passes perpendicular through the filter membrane, and is used to remove particles, microorganisms and virus particles. Both depth filters and sterilizing-grade filters fall into this category.

blocks.zh: CFF (Cross Flow Filtration / 交叉流過濾)：液體平行於濾膜表面流動，用於濃縮和緩衝液交換。在下游純化中常稱為 TFF (Tangential Flow Filtration)。
blocks.en: CFF (Cross Flow Filtration): The liquid flows parallel to the membrane surface, and is used for concentration and buffer exchange. In downstream purification it is often called TFF (Tangential Flow Filtration).

blocks.zh: Disposable Flow Path (拋棄式流路)：目前的 SU 平板式 CFF 設備其實是「半一次性」的 — 產品接觸的流路（接口、墊片、膜匣）是一次性的，但壓緊和支撐的不鏽鋼支架是重複使用的。
blocks.en: Disposable Flow Path: Current SU flat-sheet CFF equipment is in fact "semi-single-use": the product-contact flow path (ports, gaskets, cassettes) is single-use, but the stainless steel holder used for compression and support is reusable.

blocks.zh: NFF 就像咖啡濾紙 — 水從上方直直穿過濾紙，渣滓被攔截在上面。CFF 則像洗腎機 — 血液沿著膜管橫向流動，小分子通過膜壁被濾出，大分子繼續流動回體內。這兩種完全不同的過濾原理決定了它們在製程中的不同角色。
blocks.en: NFF is like a coffee filter: water passes straight down through the paper and the grounds are retained on top. CFF is like a dialysis machine: blood flows along the membrane tube, small molecules pass through the membrane wall and are filtered out, and large molecules keep flowing back to the body. These two completely different filtration principles determine their different roles in the process.

blocks.zh: Gamma 滅菌 vs 蒸汽滅菌對完整性測試的影響：這是一個非常重要但容易被忽略的觀點。傳統的 PUPSIT（使用前滅菌後完整性測試）源於蒸汽滅菌可能損壞濾器的風險（如高溫導致膜收縮、密封失效等）。然而，gamma 射線滅菌並不存在這些損壞機制，因此從「技術角度」來看，對 gamma 滅菌的除菌過濾器進行 PUPSIT 的必要性較低。
blocks.en: Impact of gamma sterilization vs steam sterilization on integrity testing: This is a very important point that is easy to overlook. Traditional PUPSIT (pre-use post-sterilization integrity testing) arose from the risk that steam sterilization may damage the filter (for example, high temperature causing membrane shrinkage or seal failure). Gamma irradiation does not have these damage mechanisms, so from a "technical perspective" the need to perform PUPSIT on gamma-sterilized sterilizing-grade filters is lower.

blocks.zh: 但請注意：法規層面上，許多監管機構仍要求進行 PUPSIT，不論滅菌方式為何。這是一個技術觀點與法規要求可能不完全一致的領域。
blocks.en: Note, however, that from a regulatory standpoint many regulatory authorities still require PUPSIT regardless of the sterilization method. This is an area where the technical view and the regulatory requirement may not fully align.

blocks.zh: 為什麼中空纖維（hollow fiber）CFF 比平板式（flat-sheet）CFF 更容易被分類為完全一次性設備？從結構設計的角度思考。
blocks.en: Why is hollow fiber CFF more readily classified as fully single-use equipment than flat-sheet CFF? Think from the structural design perspective.

blocks.zh: 如果你要將一個傳統不鏽鋼過濾系統轉換為 SUS，最重要的評估項目是什麼？
blocks.en: If you are converting a traditional stainless steel filtration system to SUS, what is the most important item to assess?

blocks.zh: Gamma 射線滅菌的 SU 濾器是否完全不需要做完整性測試？請區分 pre-use 和 post-use 測試的不同意義。
blocks.en: Do gamma-sterilized SU filters need no integrity testing at all? Distinguish the different meanings of pre-use and post-use testing.

blocks.zh: 4.12 Centrifugation 離心
blocks.en: 4.12 Centrifugation

blocks.zh: SU Centrifugation（一次性離心）：傳統離心機需要繁複的 CIP/SIP 程序來清洗和滅菌產品接觸面。SU 離心系統使用 gamma 射線預滅菌的一次性模組或高分子內襯，直接消除了清洗和滅菌的需求。
blocks.en: SU Centrifugation: Traditional centrifuges require complex CIP/SIP procedures to clean and sterilize the product contact surfaces. SU centrifugation systems use gamma pre-sterilized single-use modules or polymer liners, which directly eliminates the need for cleaning and sterilization.

blocks.zh: 應用範圍：主要用於低剪切力的分離操作，包括收穫澄清（harvest clarification）、細胞濃縮/洗滌/收穫，以及細胞分離。流速範圍從 <10 L/min 到 100 L/min，G 力從 <100X 到 8000X。
blocks.en: Range of application: Mainly low-shear separation operations, including harvest clarification, cell concentration/washing/harvesting, and cell separation. Flow rates range from <10 L/min to 100 L/min, and G forces from <100X to 8000X.

blocks.zh: 傳統離心機就像餐廳的大型洗碗機 — 每次使用後都要徹底清洗和消毒。而 SU 離心模組就像免洗餐具 — 使用後直接丟棄，省去了清洗的時間和人力成本。對於 CDMO 來說，這意味著換批（changeover）時間大幅縮短。
blocks.en: A traditional centrifuge is like the large dishwasher in a restaurant: it must be thoroughly cleaned and disinfected after every use. An SU centrifugation module is like disposable tableware: it is discarded after use, saving the time and labor cost of cleaning. For a CDMO, this means much shorter changeover time between batches.

blocks.zh: 新興技術：文件使用「emerging」一詞描述 SU 離心技術，表示在 2014 年撰寫時這仍是相對較新的領域。此後已有更多商業化產品問世（如 kSep、Carr Centritech 等），但在選用時仍需仔細評估其處理能力、剪切力對產品的影響，以及一次性模組的成本效益。
blocks.en: Emerging technology: The document uses the word "emerging" to describe SU centrifugation, indicating that this was still a relatively new field when it was written in 2014. More commercial products have appeared since (such as kSep and Carr Centritech), but when selecting one you still need to evaluate its processing capacity, the effect of shear on the product, and the cost-effectiveness of the single-use modules.

blocks.zh: SU 離心與傳統離心相比，在換批效率和交叉污染風險控制方面有何優勢？
blocks.en: Compared with traditional centrifugation, what advantages does SU centrifugation offer in changeover efficiency and control of cross-contamination risk?

blocks.zh: 為什麼文件強調 SU 離心特別適用於「低剪切力分離」？高剪切力會對生物製品造成什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does the document stress that SU centrifugation is especially suitable for "low-shear separation"? What effect can high shear have on biological products?

blocks.zh: 4.13 Chromatography 層析
blocks.en: 4.13 Chromatography

blocks.zh: Resin-based vs Membrane-based Chromatography（樹脂基 vs 膜基層析）：
blocks.en: Resin-based vs Membrane-based Chromatography:

blocks.zh: 樹脂基（Bead-based）：與傳統層析柱使用相同的填充樹脂，只是管柱材料從玻璃/不鏽鋼改為塑膠。預充填管柱可重複使用（campaign mode），適合需要高結合容量的捕獲步驟（capture step）。
blocks.en: Resin-based (bead-based): Uses the same packed resin as traditional chromatography columns; only the column material changes from glass/stainless steel to plastic. Pre-packed columns can be reused (campaign mode) and suit capture steps that require high binding capacity.

blocks.zh: 膜基（Membrane adsorbers）：以膜為載體，經化學修飾接上配體（ligand）。流速高但結合容量低，因此主要用於精製步驟（polishing），如去除殘留的 DNA、HCP 或病毒。
blocks.en: Membrane-based (membrane adsorbers): The membrane serves as the support and is chemically modified to carry a ligand. Flow rates are high but binding capacity is low, so they are used mainly for polishing steps, such as removing residual DNA, HCP or viruses.

blocks.zh: Chemical Sanitization（化學消毒）：與其他 SUS 不同，預充填樹脂管柱無法用 gamma 射線或濕熱滅菌（會破壞樹脂），必須使用 NaOH 等化學消毒劑進行嚴格的清洗消毒。
blocks.en: Chemical Sanitization: Unlike other SUS, pre-packed resin columns cannot be sterilized by gamma irradiation or moist heat (which would damage the resin), so they must be rigorously cleaned and sanitized with chemical agents such as NaOH.

blocks.zh: 樹脂基層析柱就像是用即棄塑膠杯裝的高級濾掛咖啡 — 裡面的咖啡粉（樹脂）品質跟傳統陶瓷壺用的一樣好，只是外面的容器變成了塑膠。而膜基層析則像是快速濾水壺的濾芯 — 水流通過快，適合最後的精製處理，但不適合大量的初步分離。
blocks.en: A resin-based chromatography column is like premium drip-bag coffee served in a disposable plastic cup: the coffee grounds (resin) are as good as those used in a traditional ceramic pot, only the outer container is now plastic. Membrane-based chromatography is like the filter cartridge of a quick water filter jug: water flows through quickly, which suits final polishing but not large-scale initial separation.

blocks.zh: 放大性（Scalability）很關鍵：文件特別提醒要確保所選方法能夠從 SU 規模放大到更大的 SUS 或轉回 MUS。這對於 CDMO 而言尤其重要 — 客戶的產品可能需要從小批量生產放大到商業規模。
blocks.en: Scalability is critical: The document specifically reminds users to ensure that the chosen method can be scaled up from SU scale to a larger SUS, or transferred back to multi-use systems (MUS). This is especially important for a CDMO, since a customer's product may need to scale from small-batch production to commercial scale.

blocks.zh: 緩衝液用量：無論是傳統層析還是 SU 層析，都需要大量緩衝液，這牽涉到流體管理（4.8.1）和運輸（4.17）的問題。對 CDMO 來說，緩衝液的配製和供應鏈管理是一個重要的營運考量。
blocks.en: Buffer volumes: Both traditional and SU chromatography require large volumes of buffer, which involves fluid management (4.8.1) and transportation (4.17). For a CDMO, buffer preparation and supply chain management are an important operational consideration.

blocks.zh: 為什麼膜吸附器（membrane adsorbers）適合用於精製步驟而非捕獲步驟？請從流速和結合容量兩個角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why are membrane adsorbers suited to polishing steps rather than capture steps? Explain from the perspectives of flow rate and binding capacity.

blocks.zh: 使用預充填 SU 層析柱進行 campaign 製造時，需要注意哪些與清潔消毒相關的風險？
blocks.en: When running campaign manufacturing with pre-packed SU chromatography columns, what cleaning and sanitization risks need attention?

blocks.zh: 從 CDMO 的角度，使用 SU 層析柱相較於傳統不鏽鋼柱，在供應鏈和庫存管理方面有什麼挑戰？
blocks.en: From a CDMO perspective, what supply chain and inventory management challenges does using SU chromatography columns pose compared with traditional stainless steel columns?

blocks.zh: 4.14 Drug Product Final Filling 藥品最終充填
blocks.en: 4.14 Drug Product Final Filling

blocks.zh: Drug Product Final Filling（藥品最終充填）：這是整個生產流程中風險最高的環節之一。文件開宗明義指出：「任何最終充填操作的失敗影響都很大，因為後續處理無法減少此階段的品質缺陷。」換言之，充填後無法再「補救」。
blocks.en: Drug Product Final Filling: This is one of the highest-risk steps in the entire production process. The document opens by stating: "the impact of any failure in final filling operations is high since subsequent processing cannot reduce quality defects at this stage". In other words, once filled, there is no way to "put it right".

blocks.zh: Volumetric vs Gravimetric（容積式 vs 重量式）：
blocks.en: Volumetric vs Gravimetric:

blocks.zh: 容積式：蠕動泵或正位移泵（旋轉活塞/滾動膜片），通過控制泵管壓縮量來控制體積。速度較快但精度受管路老化影響。
blocks.en: Volumetric: Peristaltic or positive displacement pumps (rotary piston/rolling diaphragm), where the volume is controlled by the degree of pump tubing compression. Faster, but accuracy is affected by tubing aging.

blocks.zh: 重量式：使用光學感測器和重力，根據管路內容積計算充填重量。精度高但產速較慢，適合低產量應用。
blocks.en: Gravimetric: Uses optical sensors and gravity to calculate the fill weight from the volume in the tubing. High accuracy but lower throughput, suited to low-volume applications.

blocks.zh: 容積式充填就像用量杯倒水 — 你依據容器的標線來量取固定體積，但量杯本身可能因使用而變形（類似泵管老化導致的系統性偏移）。重量式充填則像用電子秤精確稱量 — 不受容器形狀影響，但每次都要等秤穩定讀數，所以速度較慢。
blocks.en: Volumetric filling is like pouring water with a measuring cup: you measure a fixed volume against the graduation mark, but the cup itself may deform with use (like the systematic drift caused by pump tubing aging). Gravimetric filling is like weighing precisely on an electronic scale: it is unaffected by container shape, but you have to wait for the scale to settle each time, so it is slower.

blocks.zh: 泵管壽命與劑量偏移：文件特別提到「polymeric parts (such as pump tubing) that can lead to a systematic drift in dosing volume」。這是 SUS 充填系統的一個關鍵挑戰 — 蠕動泵管在反覆壓縮後會逐漸變形（疲勞），導致每次壓縮推出的體積緩慢漂移。必須建立 in-line weight check 來即時監控。
blocks.en: Pump tubing life and dose drift: The document specifically mentions "polymeric parts (such as pump tubing) that can lead to a systematic drift in dosing volume". This is a key challenge of SUS filling systems: peristaltic pump tubing gradually deforms (fatigues) under repeated compression, so the volume delivered by each compression slowly drifts. An in-line weight check must be established for real-time monitoring.

blocks.zh: VHP 相容性：如果 SUS 要放入使用 VPHP（vapor-phase hydrogen peroxide，氣相過氧化氫）消毒的隔離器或 RABS 中，必須確認 SUS 材料與 VPHP 的相容性，包括遮蔽效應（shadowing）和滲透性。
blocks.en: VHP compatibility: If the SUS is to be placed in an isolator or RABS decontaminated with VPHP (vapor-phase hydrogen peroxide), the compatibility of the SUS materials with VPHP must be confirmed, including shadowing and permeability.

blocks.zh: 內毒素與微粒控制：充填系統必須符合 USP <788>（微粒）和 USP <85>（內毒素）等多國藥典要求。
blocks.en: Endotoxin and particulate control: The filling system must meet multi-pharmacopoeia requirements such as USP <788> (particulate matter) and USP <85> (endotoxin).

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，在評估 SU 充填系統時的決策矩陣：
blocks.en: Decision matrix for a CDMO evaluating SU filling systems:

blocks.zh: 高產量產品（>100,000 瓶/批）：可能仍需傳統不鏽鋼系統 + SU 管路，蠕動泵多通道並聯提高產速
blocks.en: High-volume products (>100,000 vials/batch): A traditional stainless steel system with SU tubing may still be needed, with multiple peristaltic pump channels in parallel to increase throughput

blocks.zh: 低產量/高價值產品：全 SU 重量式系統可最大化精度、最小化交叉污染風險
blocks.en: Low-volume/high-value products: A fully SU gravimetric system maximizes accuracy and minimizes cross-contamination risk

blocks.zh: Campaign 製造：需要確認 SU 部件的使用壽命是否能覆蓋整個 campaign 週期
blocks.en: Campaign manufacturing: Confirm that the service life of the SU components covers the whole campaign period

blocks.zh: 為什麼最終充填被視為「不可逆的品質關卡」？從無菌保證的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why is final filling regarded as an "irreversible quality gate"? Explain from the perspective of sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 蠕動泵管的「系統性劑量偏移」如何影響充填精度？你會建議什麼樣的監控策略？
blocks.en: How does the "systematic dose drift" of peristaltic pump tubing affect filling accuracy? What monitoring strategy would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 將 SU 充填組件轉移到隔離器中時，需要驗證哪些 VPHP 相關的風險？
blocks.en: When transferring SU filling assemblies into an isolator, which VPHP-related risks need to be verified?

blocks.zh: 4.15 Isolators 隔離器
blocks.en: 4.15 Isolators

blocks.zh: Alpha-Beta (A-B) Port（阿法-貝塔接口）：這是隔離器上的無菌傳遞接口。「Alpha」端裝在隔離器壁上，「Beta」端裝在轉運容器（傳統上是不鏽鋼罐）上。兩個端口對接後打開，讓物料在不破壞隔離器無菌環境的情況下進出。SUS 的創新是用一次性袋體取代傳統的不鏽鋼 Beta 罐，大幅簡化了清洗和滅菌流程。
blocks.en: Alpha-Beta (A-B) Port: This is the aseptic transfer port on an isolator. The "Alpha" part is mounted on the isolator wall and the "Beta" part on the transfer container (traditionally a stainless steel canister). Once the two parts are docked, they are opened so that materials can enter or leave without breaching the sterile environment of the isolator. The SUS innovation is to replace the traditional stainless steel Beta canister with a single-use bag, greatly simplifying cleaning and sterilization.

blocks.zh: Aseptic Transfer（無菌傳遞）：在隔離器或 RABS 環境中，任何物料的進出都是無菌屏障的潛在破口。SU 袋體設計為不可重複使用，避免了重複使用可能帶來的交叉污染風險。
blocks.en: Aseptic Transfer: In an isolator or RABS environment, any movement of material in or out is a potential breach of the sterile barrier. SU bags are designed not to be reused, which avoids the cross-contamination risk that reuse could bring.

blocks.zh: A-B 接口就像太空站的對接口 — 太空船（Beta 端/SU 袋）必須與太空站（Alpha 端/隔離器）精確對接，才能在不讓外太空（非無菌環境）侵入的情況下傳遞物資。SU 袋取代不鏽鋼罐，就像從可重複使用的太空貨運艙改為一次性太空包裹 — 更簡便，但必須確保每個包裹與對接口完全相容。
blocks.en: An A-B port is like the docking port of a space station: the spacecraft (Beta part/SU bag) must dock precisely with the space station (Alpha part/isolator) so that supplies can be passed across without letting outer space (the non-sterile environment) in. Replacing the stainless steel canister with an SU bag is like changing from a reusable space cargo module to a disposable space package: simpler, but you must ensure that every package is fully compatible with the docking port.

blocks.zh: 供應商鎖定風險：文件明確指出「commercially available aseptic transfer ports have complementary bags that must be obtained from the same suppliers」。這意味著選擇了某一品牌的 A-B 接口後，就必須使用該品牌的配套袋體，形成供應商鎖定（vendor lock-in）。這對 CDMO 的供應鏈多元化策略是一個挑戰。
blocks.en: Vendor lock-in risk: The document explicitly states that "commercially available aseptic transfer ports have complementary bags that must be obtained from the same suppliers". This means that once you choose one brand of A-B port, you must use that brand's matching bags, creating vendor lock-in. This is a challenge for a CDMO's supply chain diversification strategy.

blocks.zh: 抗靜電膜：傳遞粉末或小零件時可能需要使用抗靜電膜，以防止靜電吸附造成的損失或污染。
blocks.en: Anti-static film: Anti-static film may be needed when transferring powders or small parts, to prevent loss or contamination caused by static adhesion.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SU 傳遞袋被設計為「防止重複使用」？從無菌保證的角度分析其重要性。
blocks.en: Why are SU transfer bags designed to "prevent reuse"? Analyze its importance from the perspective of sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: Gamma 滅菌和高壓蒸汽滅菌各適用於哪些類型的 SU 傳遞袋？各有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: Which types of SU transfer bags are suited to gamma sterilization and which to autoclaving? What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?

blocks.zh: 在選擇 A-B 接口系統時，如何平衡「供應商鎖定」風險與「系統相容性」需求？
blocks.en: When selecting an A-B port system, how do you balance the "vendor lock-in" risk against the need for "system compatibility"?

blocks.zh: 4.16 Sampling and Laboratory Analysis 取樣與實驗室分析
blocks.en: 4.16 Sampling and Laboratory Analysis

blocks.zh: Sampling in SUS（SUS 取樣）：取樣是品質控制的基礎操作，但在 SUS 環境中面臨獨特的挑戰。每次取樣都是對無菌屏障的一次「侵入」，因此取樣設計必須在分析需求和系統完整性之間取得平衡。
blocks.en: Sampling in SUS: Sampling is a basic quality control operation, but it poses unique challenges in a SUS environment. Every sampling event is an "intrusion" into the sterile barrier, so the sampling design must balance analytical needs against system integrity.

blocks.zh: Representative Sample（代表性樣品）：文件特別強調要注意管路中的「滯留區」（stagnant parts），在取樣前必須先沖洗排出滯留液體，以確保取得的樣品能代表實際製程流體的狀態。
blocks.en: Representative Sample: The document specifically stresses attention to "stagnant parts" in the tubing. Before sampling, the stagnant liquid must be flushed out so that the sample represents the actual state of the process fluid.

blocks.zh: SUS 取樣就像從密封的無塵室中取出物品 — 每開一次門就增加一次污染風險。預組裝的取樣歧管（manifold）設計就像設置了一系列「安全抽屜」：每次只拉出一個抽屜取樣，用完後密封切斷，不影響其他抽屜和主系統的無菌狀態。
blocks.en: SUS sampling is like taking items out of a sealed cleanroom: every time the door is opened, the contamination risk increases. A pre-assembled sampling manifold is like a series of "safety drawers": only one drawer is pulled out at a time for sampling, then sealed and cut off after use, without affecting the other drawers or the sterility of the main system.

blocks.zh: 酒精消毒的局限性：文件明確指出「using alcohol to sanitize a port before entry does not ensure sterility」— 酒精擦拭只能降低生物負載，不能保證無菌。同時還要注意酒精可能污染取樣液體，影響分析結果。
blocks.en: Limitations of alcohol sanitization: The document explicitly states that "using alcohol to sanitize a port before entry does not ensure sterility": alcohol wiping only reduces bioburden and cannot guarantee sterility. Note also that alcohol may contaminate the sampled liquid and affect the analytical results.

blocks.zh: 樣品品質驗證：SU 取樣容器（袋、管路）本身可能對分析方法產生正向或負向干擾（interference），或導致樣品降解。在建立取樣方法前，必須評估這些因素。
blocks.en: Sample quality verification: The SU sampling containers (bags, tubing) may themselves cause positive or negative interference with the analytical method, or cause sample degradation. These factors must be evaluated before the sampling method is established.

blocks.zh: 在設計 SUS 取樣方案時，為什麼需要提前確定所需的取樣次數？這如何影響 SUS 的設計？
blocks.en: When designing a SUS sampling plan, why is it necessary to determine the required number of samples in advance? How does this affect the SUS design?

blocks.zh: 管路中的「滯留區」如何影響樣品代表性？你會建議什麼操作措施來解決這個問題？
blocks.en: How do "stagnant parts" in the tubing affect sample representativeness? What operational measures would you recommend to address this?

blocks.zh: 對於需要長期儲存的關鍵製程樣品，應如何驗證 SU 容器對樣品穩定性的影響？
blocks.en: For critical process samples that need long-term storage, how should the effect of the SU container on sample stability be verified?

blocks.zh: 4.17 Transportation 運輸
blocks.en: 4.17 Transportation

blocks.zh: Transportation in SUS（SUS 運輸）：運輸不僅指廠際之間的長距離運輸，也包括廠區內部不同房間或潔淨區之間的物料移動。SUS 的運輸需要考慮袋體保護、流體波動抑制、環境控制和潔淨度等級維護等多重因素。
blocks.en: Transportation in SUS: Transportation covers not only long-distance transport between sites but also material movement between different rooms or cleanrooms within a site. SUS transportation must take into account multiple factors, including bag protection, suppression of fluid movement, environmental control and maintenance of cleanliness grades.

blocks.zh: Progressive Removal of Packaging（逐層拆除包裝）：將 SUS 袋體從非潔淨區移入潔淨區時，需要逐層移除外包裝，並在每個等級轉換點進行擦拭/消毒，以確保進入更高潔淨等級的物品不會帶入污染物。
blocks.en: Progressive Removal of Packaging: When moving SUS bags from a non-classified area into a cleanroom, the outer packaging must be removed layer by layer, with wiping/disinfection at each grade transition point, to ensure that items entering a higher cleanliness grade do not carry in contaminants.

blocks.zh: 這就像醫院的「層層消毒」概念 — 手術器械從外部運入手術室時，要經過層層拆包和消毒：最外層包裝在走廊拆除，次外層在緩衝區拆除並擦拭，最後在手術室內才打開無菌包裝。SUS 的運輸與跨潔淨等級轉移遵循同樣的邏輯。
blocks.en: This is like the hospital concept of "layer-by-layer disinfection": when surgical instruments are brought into the operating room from outside, they pass through successive stages of unwrapping and disinfection. The outermost wrapping is removed in the corridor, the next layer is removed and wiped in the buffer area, and the sterile pack is opened only inside the operating room. SUS transportation and transfer across cleanliness grades follow the same logic.

blocks.zh: Wave Action（液體波動）：大容量袋（可達 1000 L）在運輸過程中，液體的劇烈晃動可能對袋體接縫和管路連接處造成應力，增加洩漏風險。因此需要使用蓋子或機械裝置來抑制波動。
blocks.en: Wave Action: During transportation of large bags (up to 1000 L), vigorous sloshing of the liquid can stress the bag seams and tubing connections and increase the risk of leakage. Lids or mechanical devices are therefore needed to suppress the movement.

blocks.zh: 舊設施 vs 新設施：文件特別指出「material management capability may vary significantly between an existing facility and a new facility」。舊設施可能缺乏足夠的暫存區、走廊空間和廢料處理能力來支持 SUS 的大量包裝和廢料流。這是許多工廠在導入 SUS 時容易低估的問題。
blocks.en: Existing vs new facilities: The document specifically notes that "material management capability may vary significantly between an existing facility and a new facility". Older facilities may lack sufficient staging areas, corridor space and waste handling capacity to support the large packaging and waste streams of SUS. This is a problem that many plants easily underestimate when introducing SUS.

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO 設施規劃者，導入 SUS 前你需要評估：
blocks.en: As a CDMO facility planner, before introducing SUS you need to assess:

blocks.zh: 暫存空間：SUS 元件體積大但輕，需要比傳統不鏽鋼系統更多的倉儲面積
blocks.en: Staging space: SUS components are bulky but light, and need more storage area than traditional stainless steel systems

blocks.zh: 廢料處理：使用後的大量塑膠廢料需要專門的處理和移除通道
blocks.en: Waste handling: The large volume of plastic waste after use needs dedicated handling and removal routes

blocks.zh: 人流物流動線：大型外容器（tote、drum）的搬運路線是否與現有走廊和門寬相容
blocks.en: Personnel and material flow: Whether the handling routes for large outer containers (totes, drums) are compatible with existing corridors and door widths

blocks.zh: 堆高機通道：確保堆高機可以到達所需區域，且外容器可堆疊存放
blocks.en: Forklift access: Ensure forklifts can reach the required areas and that outer containers can be stacked for storage

blocks.zh: 為什麼運輸過程中需要抑制袋內液體的「波動效應」？這與袋體完整性有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why does the "wave effect" of liquid in the bag need to be suppressed during transportation? How does it relate to bag integrity?

blocks.zh: 從潔淨度等級（C 到 B 級）轉移時，「逐層拆除包裝」的操作程序應如何設計？
blocks.en: When transferring from one cleanliness grade to another (grade C to B), how should the "progressive removal of packaging" procedure be designed?

blocks.zh: 舊有設施整合 SUS 時，在物料管理方面可能面臨哪些挑戰？
blocks.en: What material management challenges may arise when integrating SUS into an existing facility?

blocks.zh: 4.18 Sensors 感測器
blocks.en: 4.18 Sensors

blocks.zh: SU Sensor（一次性感測器）：感測器是 SUS 的「眼睛和耳朵」，提供製程參數數據以實現手動或自動化的製程控制與監控。SU 感測器的三種形式：
blocks.en: SU Sensor: Sensors are the "eyes and ears" of SUS, providing process parameter data for manual or automated process control and monitoring. SU sensors come in three forms:

blocks.zh: 直接整合式：感測器直接嵌入 SU 袋體或管路中，隨系統一起丟棄
blocks.en: Directly integrated: The sensor is embedded directly in the SU bag or tubing and discarded together with the system

blocks.zh: 流路屏障式：傳統感測器搭配流路屏障（如膜片），探頭不直接接觸產品
blocks.en: Flow path barrier: A traditional sensor is paired with a flow path barrier (such as a membrane), so the probe does not contact the product directly

blocks.zh: 混合式（Hybrid）：結合感測器和轉換器，部分一次性、部分重複使用
blocks.en: Hybrid: Combines sensor and transducer, partly single-use and partly reusable

blocks.zh: 常規測量參數：溫度、壓力、電導度已成熟；pH、溶氧（DO）和 CO2 的 SU 感測器則較新，採用化學或光學技術。
blocks.en: Routine measured parameters: Temperature, pressure and conductivity are mature; SU sensors for pH, dissolved oxygen (DO) and CO2 are newer and use chemical or optical technologies.

blocks.zh: 傳統不鏽鋼系統中的感測器就像家裡的固定式溫度計和濕度計 — 安裝好後反覆使用，定期校準。SU 感測器則像即棄式醫療體溫計 — 用完就丟，免去了交叉污染的風險和重新校準的麻煩，但成本較高且需要確保每支都準確。
blocks.en: A sensor in a traditional stainless steel system is like the fixed thermometer and hygrometer at home: installed once, used repeatedly and calibrated regularly. An SU sensor is like a disposable medical thermometer: it is discarded after use, which removes the cross-contamination risk and the recalibration effort, but it costs more and you must ensure that every unit is accurate.

blocks.zh: 校準挑戰：傳統感測器可以在使用前進行完整的多點校準。SU 感測器由於是一次性的，校準策略不同 — 有些依賴出廠預校準，有些支持簡化的使用前校準。使用後驗證（post-use verification）的便利性也是評估的重要因素。
blocks.en: Calibration challenges: Traditional sensors can undergo a full multi-point calibration before use. Because SU sensors are single-use, the calibration strategy is different: some rely on factory pre-calibration and some support simplified pre-use calibration. The ease of post-use verification is also an important evaluation factor.

blocks.zh: 跨操作平台的一致性：文件強調需要考慮是否能在多個單元操作中使用相同的感測平台。如果不同步驟使用不同的感測技術（每種都有不同的量測範圍、精度和準確度），數據的可比性和製程控制策略的一致性都會受到影響。
blocks.en: Consistency across unit operations: The document stresses considering whether the same sensing platform can be used across multiple unit operations. If different steps use different sensing technologies (each with a different measuring range, precision and accuracy), the comparability of data and the consistency of the process control strategy will be affected.

blocks.zh: 滅菌相容性：SU 感測器必須能承受所選的滅菌方法（通常是 gamma 射線），同時在滅菌後仍保持測量精度，這是技術上的一大挑戰。
blocks.en: Sterilization compatibility: SU sensors must withstand the chosen sterilization method (usually gamma irradiation) and still maintain measurement accuracy afterwards, which is a major technical challenge.

blocks.zh: SU pH 感測器與傳統玻璃 pH 電極相比，在校準和精度方面有何不同？各有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: How do SU pH sensors differ from traditional glass pH electrodes in calibration and accuracy? What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?

blocks.zh: 為什麼在選擇 SU 感測器時需要考慮「跨單元操作的通用平台」？這對數據完整性有何影響？
blocks.en: Why should a "common platform across unit operations" be considered when selecting SU sensors? What does this mean for data integrity?

blocks.zh: Gamma 射線滅菌可能對光學式感測器的哪些特性產生影響？如何驗證滅菌後的感測器性能？
blocks.en: Which characteristics of optical sensors may be affected by gamma sterilization? How would you verify sensor performance after sterilization?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 儲存 (4.9)：PE 接液層是最常見的選擇；對於氧敏性或光敏性中間體需要特殊保護膜（如 EVOH 氣體阻隔層）。Leachables 評估在長期儲存中至關重要。
blocks.en: Storage (4.9): A PE fluid contact layer is the most common choice; oxygen-sensitive or light-sensitive intermediates need special protective films (such as an EVOH gas barrier layer). Leachables assessment is critical for long-term storage.

blocks.zh: 冷凍 (4.10)：控制凍融系統使用接觸式冷凍板確保均勻冷凍，在 -40°C 至 -70°C 下大多數高分子材料會低於玻璃轉化溫度而變脆。管路接頭是最常見的失效點，人員培訓至關重要。
blocks.en: Freezing (4.10): Controlled freeze-thaw systems use contact freezing plates to ensure uniform freezing; at -40°C to -70°C most polymer materials fall below their glass transition temperature and become brittle. Tubing connections are the most common failure point, and personnel training is essential.

blocks.zh: 過濾 (4.11)：NFF 和中空纖維 CFF 最適合 SU 格式。Gamma 射線滅菌的濾器在技術上對 PUPSIT 的需求較低（不同於蒸汽滅菌），但法規可能仍有要求。
blocks.en: Filtration (4.11): NFF and hollow fiber CFF are best suited to the SU format. For gamma-sterilized filters the need for PUPSIT is technically lower (unlike steam sterilization), but regulators may still require it.

blocks.zh: 離心 (4.12)：SU 離心為新興技術，使用 gamma 預滅菌的一次性模組/內襯，消除了 CIP/SIP 需求，適用於低剪切力的收穫和澄清操作。
blocks.en: Centrifugation (4.12): SU centrifugation is an emerging technology that uses gamma pre-sterilized single-use modules/liners, eliminating the need for CIP/SIP, and suits low-shear harvest and clarification operations.

blocks.zh: 層析 (4.13)：分為樹脂基（預充填管柱，可 campaign 使用，需化學消毒）和膜基（膜吸附器，高流速低容量，用於精製步驟）。放大性和緩衝液需求是關鍵考量。
blocks.en: Chromatography (4.13): Divided into resin-based (pre-packed columns, usable in campaigns, requiring chemical sanitization) and membrane-based (membrane adsorbers, high flow rate and low capacity, used for polishing steps). Scalability and buffer requirements are key considerations.

blocks.zh: 最終充填 (4.14)：風險最高的環節 — 充填後無法補救品質缺陷。容積式和重量式兩種劑量控制方式各有優缺；蠕動泵管壽命導致的系統性劑量偏移是 SUS 特有的挑戰。
blocks.en: Final filling (4.14): The highest-risk step: quality defects cannot be remedied after filling. The volumetric and gravimetric dose control methods each have advantages and disadvantages; systematic dose drift from peristaltic pump tubing life is a challenge specific to SUS.

blocks.zh: 隔離器 (4.15)：SU 袋體取代傳統不鏽鋼 Beta 罐用於 A-B 接口的無菌傳遞。供應商鎖定（vendor lock-in）是重要的供應鏈風險。
blocks.en: Isolators (4.15): SU bags replace the traditional stainless steel Beta canister for aseptic transfer through A-B ports. Vendor lock-in is an important supply chain risk.

blocks.zh: 取樣 (4.16)：每次取樣都是對無菌屏障的侵入。預組裝取樣歧管可降低風險；需注意管路滯留區對樣品代表性的影響，以及 SU 容器對分析方法的潛在干擾。
blocks.en: Sampling (4.16): Every sampling event is an intrusion into the sterile barrier. Pre-assembled sampling manifolds reduce the risk; attention is needed to the effect of stagnant parts in the tubing on sample representativeness and to potential interference of SU containers with analytical methods.

blocks.zh: 運輸 (4.17)：涵蓋廠內和廠際運輸；大容量袋的液體波動抑制、跨潔淨等級的逐層拆包、以及舊設施的物料管理能力（暫存空間、廢料處理）是常被低估的挑戰。
blocks.en: Transportation (4.17): Covers both on-site and inter-site transport; suppression of fluid movement in large bags, progressive removal of packaging across cleanliness grades, and the material management capability of existing facilities (staging space, waste handling) are often underestimated challenges.

blocks.zh: 感測器 (4.18)：SU 感測器提供製程控制所需的參數數據；溫度/壓力/電導度已成熟，pH/DO/CO2 為較新技術。校準策略、滅菌相容性、以及跨操作平台的一致性是評估的關鍵要素。
blocks.en: Sensors (4.18): SU sensors provide the parameter data needed for process control; temperature/pressure/conductivity are mature, while pH/DO/CO2 are newer technologies. Calibration strategy, sterilization compatibility and consistency across unit operations are the key evaluation factors.
